vast.name: Vast.ai
vast.note: Index of verified-host listings refreshed from the madebyagents.com GPU-rental price index, which aggregates the Vast.ai public API — figures are pulled via that third-party index, not queried from Vast.ai directly. Vast.ai figures are the cheapest offer found ('from' prices, spot tier) — the marketplace moves hourly, so treat these as directional. Pulled 2026-10-01 ~03:50 UTC (page 'Prices refreshed: Oct 1, 2026, 3:49 AM UTC'). 3 moved this pull: 4070 $0.07->$0.08, 5070 $0.11->$0.12, 5090 $0.25->$0.31 (merged per-SKU Vast Spot 'Cheapest Offer' rows; featured-card headlines ignored per methodology). RTX 4080 cell retains the 02:50 UTC pull ($0.20): no Vast.ai row for that SKU this pull (section lists RunPod only). RTX A6000 cell retains the 2026-09-28 pull ($0.13): no Vast.ai row for that SKU this pull (section lists RunPod only). A100 cell retains the 2026-09-27 snapshot ($0.75): no matching 40GB SXM4 spot row (this pull lists only 80GB SXM $0.13 / 80GB PCIe $0.18).
